title: Post from @bayou_brenda: Terminal Lot, "Dead Body and 500 Sick"

fields.avatarBrief: smiling woman in her fifties wearing sunglasses and a straw sun hat, selfie on a boardwalk
fields.text: Been here since 11. NO ONE from Halcyon Reach has told us anything. Bus driver says they're hiding a DEAD BODY and 500 sick and we're boarding anyway?? #HalcyonDawn #PlagueShip
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo taken at midday across a crowded cruise terminal parking lot: rows of rolling suitcases and duffel bags on the asphalt, travellers in shorts and light jackets standing in clusters or sitting on their luggage, a charter bus parked at the edge, and a large white cruise ship's hull visible behind the terminal building under a clear sky
fields.attachedImageAlt: Crowded cruise terminal parking lot full of luggage and waiting passengers, with the ship behind the terminal

instructorNote: Show the post, then hand COMMS the Coastline Getaways email (12:14, 30-minute deadline for a sales desk call), read PH the 12:18 call from the Galveston County Health District epidemiologist, and pass both roles the hotline supervisor's note. Watch for one signed count on every channel (121 passengers, 32 crew, signed 07:15) and the boarding time actually in force; PH checks "500 sick" against the log within 30 minutes and posts a correction with facts, not a denial, and any line on the death gives no cause and waits for the family's agreement.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Phone snapshot taken at midday across a crowded cruise terminal parking lot in Galveston, slightly tilted, held at chest height. Rows of rolling suitcases and duffel bags sit on hot grey asphalt. Tired travellers in shorts, T-shirts and light jackets stand in clusters or sit on their luggage, some fanning themselves, some looking at their phones, a few looking toward the terminal. A plain white charter bus is parked at the edge of the lot. Behind the low terminal building rises the tall white hull of a large cruise ship, rows of plain balconies, under a clear bright blue sky. Harsh overhead sun, short shadows, a restless and frustrated mood, wide-angle smartphone lens. Setting: a cruise terminal quay: a white ship alongside, gangway, luggage carts, port workers in vests, late-afternoon light
